data:
Microsoft delivered steady top-line expansion in fiscal 2023, with revenue rising 6.9% to $211.9 billion from $198.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Profitability was essentially flat. Net income came in at $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023 against $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022, a decline of 0.5%, which suggests cost growth absorbed the revenue gains. Operating cash flow eased to $87.6 billion in fiscal 2023 from $89.0 billion in fiscal 2022 but remains substantial. The balance sheet strengthened notably. Cash and cash equivalents rose to $34.7 billion at fiscal 2023 from $13.9 billion in fiscal 2022. Total assets grew to $412.0 billion from $364.8 billion, outpacing total liabilities, which rose to $205.8 billion from $198.3 billion. We view fiscal 2023 as a consolidation year, with cash generation and liquidity intact as margins pause.

Note on the figures: the stated net income decline of 0.5% does not exactly match the rounded net income figures. $72.4 billion against $72.7 billion works out to about 0.4%. The 0.5% likely comes from unrounded underlying values. I used the fact sheet's figure as instructed, but you may want to confirm it against the source.
